title: 第三章 真咸鱼第四章 魔改
content_zh:
韩紫枫继续说：“毕竟你选的肯定一个是走修仙的，建议普通奖券可以和高级的，但不能合神级的，这样就凭高级的奖券也是可以顺利活下去的，毕竟，筑基好像就200年吧？反正你就是个暗箱操作的，不行就从高级里面偶尔轮出一个超标的呗，就比如，密集论段，再比如武器论破。”
“你感觉新手不错，还是可以暗戳戳的操作一波。普通奖券天花板是高武；高级区天花板是筑基金丹。这样的话整个设计就不会太显得废啦。自己安排一波，对了，一样奖券给咱发张，我试试手气呗，嘿嘿嘿。我可没百年给你试验一款的决心。”
霜华仙尊：“咳咳，你也应该自主修炼吧？”
紫枫回答：“老大，人家这里是科技世界，现代社会，连高武的几乎都达不到，那些修真的，也就忽悠忽悠凡人，都快跟神棍划等号啦。再说，既然号称咸鱼，那就要让人过的很咸鱼不是吗？反正你也不会干出一个神经病系统吧？”
霜华仙尊疑惑：“天花板？神经病？啥玩意？”
紫枫想一下说：“天花板，你在屋子里吗？抬头，看到屋顶没，那就是所谓的天花板。神经病，额，听过分身术没，让那些分身都具有各种不同的性格，然后你时不时的，不定期的变成其中一个分身的性子，你就是神经病啦。哦~，耶！”
霜华仙尊嘴角抽一下，好吧，明白是啥意思了，看来是哪个世界的人，对某些认知事物的换词形容啊！不过，最后的哦耶是个什么鬼？难道这个熊孩子认为，自己会傻不愣登实践一波？有点不开心啊！
所以霜华仙尊的回复是：“盘古斧你拿不动，额，我也拿不动的样子；炼药壶，那是就是个小世界好吧；复活石，嗯嗯，没见谁复活过，它能治疗濒死的人，百分百治愈。”他脑袋一抽问一句：“如果给你选，你想做什么样的人？”
紫枫回答的果然叫她很扎心：“如果可以控制血瘾，当僵尸王多爽，还有超能力呢。但凡有个生死簿，我就敢摆摊算命去。女娲后人什么的，这个念头容易被切片研究。话说，都说盘古脑子都不好，下来分分钟就能负债累累啊！话说，观音到底是男的是女的？话说，猴子现在头上还有箍没有？那个箍真的是落宝金钱吗？”
霜华仙尊有点忍无可忍啦：“停停停，这都什么鬼？”他顺着咸鱼系统，真的用神念扫一边，然后，我去，有点晕。“你们的世界，那都是什么鬼？”
紫枫想想问：“你上网啦，刺激不？现在被叫做信息大爆炸世界，网友的脑洞是真心大，并且我们号称，信仰自由，还有很多无神论者，所以，你这个老古董感觉扎心，那是很正常的。”
她选一个十抽，嗯嗯，差不多是一个个轮，出现的是：“潜能点12点，特效安眠药一瓶，抽空3次，高级抽奖劵一张，软妹币2000元。”钱到账还是很快的直接就是微信转账。
她也不多想，直接冲着投诉说：“喂喂喂，游戏都讲究10次抽9个卡就行，加上初级的还有轮空，里外里你也不亏的样子。高级的，也是可以操作的，神级，呵呵呵，貌似不成仙都凑不够吧？还有，设计个一键跳过，那么傻不兮兮的转轮子，略傻的说。一键跳过，就是直接把奖品发了，就没你什么事情啦。”
很快，她发现，重新改好，这边的十连出的是：长春功、潜能点10点，抽空2次，软妹币1300元。再单抽两把，一张高级抽奖劵，一张神级抽奖劵，再次两把，一个北冥神功，一个炼妖壶。
紫枫好奇的看炼药壶，上面的说明是，用神念温阳，可以把圣灵收入到壶中，变成灵液，灵液可根据等级，辅助修炼。
她还发现，潜能点这个东西，是可以在任何技能上加的，但魅力、悟性、气运最高是100。介于她的智力还是比较拉胯的，她直接就全点智力上，剩下两点，直接加在悟性上。
再看看特效安眠药的介绍，服用无不良反应，快速入睡无压力。注意：一片安眠药，沉睡时间8小时。
她再次无语啊，打开瓶子，满满一瓶子，盖上盖，发现，嗯嗯瓶子上写着足足200片。为啥感觉，咸鱼系统的终极目标是：睡你个投诉党。
叹口气，现在自己的页面也已经是：
姓名：韩紫枫。性别：女。

体质：20（炼气期100）。
力量：20（炼气期100）。
速度：10（炼气期100）。
韧性：20（炼气期100）。
智力：25（炼气期100）。
魅力：10（最高100）。
悟性：12（最高100）。
气运：20（最高100）。
武功：太极拳、太极剑、梯云纵、北冥神功、长春功。
装备：炼妖壶
潜能：0。
携带物品：特效安眠药一瓶，
货币：0。
她眼看着快12点了，也就吃下一片安眠药，毕竟任务还是要做的，有一点体验点是一点啊！
等她睁开眼睛，已经是第二天早上八点啦，紫枫看了眼咸鱼系统，嗯嗯，最后的货币变成体验点1。
新任务是：9点前，吃到一份美味的早餐，要求吃饱。奖励是抽奖劵1。
面对这样的系统，她简直是槽点满满，不过能说啥，赶紧给自己弄点吃的。上午的话，现在已经放假，基本也没什么事情可以做，她就想先整体了解一下这个咸鱼系统，再算下来的事情。
只是两天的时间，紫枫就抓狂啦，不为别的咸鱼系统的任务，简直是没睡啦，简直坑爹坑出新三观。现在她都知道每天要做啥啦。
每天早上7点到8点，要吃一份美味早餐，8点到11点悠闲，做点自己想做的事情。11点半到12点半，吃中午饭，吃的要丰富，要美味。12点到14点，睡午觉。

Han Zifeng continued: "After all, the one you choose must be a cultivator. It is recommended that ordinary lottery tickets can be combined with high-level ones, but not god-level ones. In this way, you can survive smoothly with high-level lottery tickets. After all, it seems that foundation building only takes 200 years? Anyway, you are a secret operation. If it doesn't work, you can occasionally choose an over-the-top one from the high-level ones, such as intensive argument paragraphs and weapons theory."
"If you think you are a good novice, you can still do it secretly. The ceiling of ordinary lottery tickets is Gaowu; the ceiling of high-end area is Foundation Building Pill. In this way, the whole design will not look too useless. Arrange a wave by yourself, by the way, give us the same lottery ticket, and I will try my luck, hehehe. I don't have the determination to test one for you in a hundred years."
Shuanghua Immortal: "Ahem, you should also practice on your own, right?"
Zifeng replied: "Boss, this is a world of science and technology. In modern society, even those with high martial arts skills can hardly reach it. Those cultivators can only fool ordinary people, and they are almost equated with magic sticks. Besides, since they are called salty fish, they have to live a very salty life, right? You can't create a psychotic system anyway, right?"
Shuanghua Immortal was confused: "Ceiling? Crazy? What the hell?"
Zifeng thought about it and said: "Ceiling, are you in the room? Look up and see if there is no roof. That is the so-called ceiling. Psycho, um, have you ever heard of the clone technique, which allows those clones to have various personalities, and then you change the temperament of one of the clones from time to time, irregularly, you are crazy. Oh~, yeah!"
The corners of Shuanghua Immortal's mouth twitched. Okay, I understand what it means. It seems that people from some world use different words to describe certain cognitive things! But what the hell is that last oh yeah? Does this naughty kid think that he is too stupid to practice it? A little unhappy!
So Shuanghua Immortal Lord's reply was: "You can't lift the Pangu Axe, well, I can't lift it either; alchemy pot, it's just a small world, okay; Resurrection Stone, uh-huh, I've never seen anyone resurrected, it can treat dying people, 100% cure." With a twitch of his head, he asked: "If I were to choose, what kind of person would you like to be?"
Zifeng's answer was really heartbreaking for her: "If I could control my blood addiction, it would be great to be a zombie king and have super powers. As long as there is a book of life and death, I would dare to set up a stall to tell fortunes. Nuwa's descendants and so on, this idea is easy to be sliced and studied. By the way, it is said that Pangu has a bad mind, and he will be in debt in a minute! By the way, is Guanyin a boy or a girl? By the way, does the monkey have a hoop on its head now? Is that hoop really the treasure money?"
Shuanghua Immortal was a little intolerable: "Stop, stop, stop, what the hell is all this?" He followed the Xianyu system and really scanned it with his spiritual thoughts, and then, I went, a little dizzy. "What the hell is that in your world?"
Zifeng wanted to ask: "You are online, isn't it exciting? Nowadays, it is called the world of information explosion. Netizens' imaginations are really big, and we claim to have freedom of belief, and there are many atheists. Therefore, it is normal for you, an old antique, to feel heartbroken."
She chose a ten-draw, uh-huh, it was almost a round, and what appeared was: "12 potential points, a bottle of special sleeping pills, 3 draws, a high-level lottery ticket, and 2,000 yuan of soft girl coins." The money arrived very quickly, directly through WeChat transfer.
She didn't think too much and complained directly: "Hey, hey, hey, all games are about drawing 9 cards out of 10 times. Plus there are byes for beginners, you won't be at a loss inside or outside. Advanced ones are also operable, and god level, hahaha, it seems like even an immortal can't get enough, right? Also, design a one-click skip, so stupid to spin the wheel, to say it is a bit silly. One-click skip, the prize will be given out directly, and you won't have anything to do."
Soon, she discovered,Modified again, the ten consecutive results here are: Changchun Gong, 10 potential points, 2 times of time, and 1,300 yuan of soft girl coins. Then draw two more, one high-level lottery ticket, one god-level lottery ticket, and two more, one Beiming Magic Skill and one Demon Refining Pot.
Zifeng looked at the alchemy pot curiously. The description on it was that by using the mind to warm the Yang, the Holy Spirit could be collected into the pot and turned into spiritual liquid. The spiritual liquid could assist cultivation according to the level.
She also discovered that potential points can be added to any skill, but the maximum for charm, understanding, and luck is 100. Since her intelligence was quite low, she just put all her points on intelligence, and the remaining two points were put directly on comprehension.
Let's take a look at the introduction of special sleeping pills. There are no adverse reactions when taking them, and you can fall asleep quickly without stress. Note: One sleeping pill lasts for 8 hours.
She was speechless again. She opened the bottle, filled it up, closed the cap, and found, yes, it said 200 tablets on the bottle. Why do I feel that the ultimate goal of the salted fish system is to sleep with you as a complaining party.
Sighing, my page is now:
Name: Han Zifeng. Gender: Female.
Constitution: 20 (Qi refining period: 100).
Strength: 20 (100 during Qi refining period).
Speed: 10 (Qi refining period: 100).
Toughness: 20 (Qi refining period: 100).
Intelligence: 25 (Qi refining period: 100).
Charisma: 10 (maximum 100).
Comprehension: 12 (maximum 100).
Luck: 20 (maximum 100).
Martial Arts: Tai Chi, Tai Chi Sword, Tiyun Zong, Beiming Shengong, Changchun Kung Fu.
Equipment: Demon Refining Pot
Potential: 0.
Items to bring: A bottle of special sleeping pills,
Currency: 0.
Seeing that it was almost 12 o'clock, she took a sleeping pill. After all, she still had to do the task, and a little experience was worth it!
When she opened her eyes, it was already eight o'clock in the morning the next day. Zifeng looked at the Xianyu system and said, "Hmm, the last currency became experience point 1."
The new task is: eat a delicious breakfast before 9 o'clock and ask to be full. The reward is raffle ticket 1.
Facing such a system, she was simply full of flaws, but what could she say, get herself something to eat quickly. In the morning, it was already on holiday, and there was basically nothing to do. She wanted to understand the salted fish system as a whole first, and then figure out what to do.
In just two days, Zifeng went crazy. He couldn't sleep at all if he wasn't working on other Xianyu System tasks. Now she knows what to do every day.
Eat a delicious breakfast from 7 to 8 a.m. every morning, take it easy from 8 to 11 a.m., and do something you want to do. Have lunch from 11:30 to 12:30. The food should be rich and delicious. From 12 o'clock to 14 o'clock, take a nap.
